'''Alexandru Ioan Lupaș''' (5 January 1942 – 14 August 2007) was a [[Romania]]n [[mathematician]].

He was born in [[Arad, Romania|Arad]], where he attended the [[Moise Nicoară National College|Moise Nicoară High School]].<ref>{{citation|url=http://www.emis.de/journals/JIPAM/images/288_07_JIPAM/288_07_www.pdf| title=Obituary: Professor Alexandru Lupaș (1942-2007)|author1=Sorin Gal|author2= Andrei Vernescu|journal=Journal of Inequalities in Pure and Applied Mathematics|volume= 8|issue= 3|pages=art. 61|year=2007}}</ref> He pursued his studies at [[Babeș-Bolyai University]] in [[Cluj-Napoca|Cluj]], obtaining a [[B.S.]] degree in Mathematics in 1964. He earned a [[Ph.D.]] degree in 1972 from the [[University of Stuttgart]], under the direction of {{ill|Werner Meyer-König|de}} and [[Friedrich Moritz Lösch]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy |id=44949}}</ref>

Lupaș then returned to work at Babeș-Bolyai University, obtaining a second Ph.D. degree in 1976 under the supervision of [[Tiberiu Popoviciu]] and [[Dimitrie D. Stancu]]. That year he moved to [[Lucian Blaga University of Sibiu]], starting as lecturer and advancing to full professor in 1990. He died in [[Sibiu]].
